CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_accounting_document_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE issued boolean;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='settlement_invoices' THEN
   IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_invoice_transition(to_jsonb(OLD),to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
   IF (OLD.source_union_presettlement_id IS NOT NULL OR
       (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.source_union_presettlement_id IS NOT NULL)) AND (TG_OP='DELETE' OR
      (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['message_sent','message_sent_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
      (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['message_sent','message_sent_at']))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'presettlement_receipt_is_immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';END IF;
   IF OLD.invoice_type='credit_limit_change' AND (TG_OP='DELETE' OR
      (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['message_sent','message_sent_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
      (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['message_sent','message_sent_at']))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'credit_change_document_is_immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';END IF;
   IF OLD.invoice_type='accounting_correction' AND (TG_OP='DELETE' OR
      ROW(NEW.status,NEW.chips_transferred,NEW.transferred_at,NEW.due_at,NEW.chip_transfer_id,NEW.adjusts_invoice_id,
          NEW.source_credit_invoice_id,NEW.source_credit_payment_id,NEW.overdue_at,NEW.reminders_sent,NEW.last_reminder_at)
      IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.status,OLD.chips_transferred,OLD.transferred_at,OLD.due_at,OLD.chip_transfer_id,OLD.adjusts_invoice_id,
          OLD.source_credit_invoice_id,OLD.source_credit_payment_id,OLD.overdue_at,OLD.reminders_sent,OLD.last_reminder_at))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'correction_document_payment_claim_is_immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';END IF;
   IF OLD.invoice_type='cashier_cashout' AND (TG_OP='DELETE' OR
      ROW(NEW.status,NEW.chips_transferred,NEW.transferred_at) IS DISTINCT FROM
      ROW(OLD.status,OLD.chips_transferred,OLD.transferred_at))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cashier_document_phase_is_immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';END IF;
   issued:=COALESCE(OLD.message_sent,false) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.accounting_invoice_deliveries WHERE invoice_id=OLD.id);
   IF issued AND (TG_OP='DELETE' OR
     ROW(NEW.club_id,NEW.period_id,NEW.invoice_type,NEW.invoice_number,NEW.from_entity_type,NEW.from_entity_id,
         NEW.to_entity_type,NEW.to_entity_id,NEW.gross_amount,NEW.net_amount,NEW.deductions,NEW.breakdown,
         NEW.due_at,NEW.notes,NEW.source_ledger_id,NEW.source_credit_invoice_id,NEW.source_credit_payment_id,NEW.created_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM
     ROW(OLD.club_id,OLD.period_id,OLD.invoice_type,OLD.invoice_number,OLD.from_entity_type,OLD.from_entity_id,
         OLD.to_entity_type,OLD.to_entity_id,OLD.gross_amount,OLD.net_amount,OLD.deductions,OLD.breakdown,
         OLD.due_at,OLD.notes,OLD.source_ledger_id,OLD.source_credit_invoice_id,OLD.source_credit_payment_id,OLD.created_at)
     OR NEW.message_sent IS DISTINCT FROM true)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'issued_accounting_invoice_is_immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='social_messages' THEN
   issued:=EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.accounting_invoice_deliveries WHERE message_id=OLD.id);
   IF issued AND (TG_OP='DELETE' OR
      (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['read_at','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['read_at','updated_at']))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'issued_accounting_message_is_immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_accounting_invoice_deliver_on_insert()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.fn_deliver_accounting_invoice(NEW.id);
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

triggers.name: cashier_event_append_only
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER cashier_event_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.accounting_cashier_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_cashier_event_append_only()

triggers.name: cashier_event_messenger_thread
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER cashier_event_messenger_thread AFTER INSERT ON public.accounting_cashier_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_cashier_event_messenger_thread()

constraints.name: accounting_cashier_events_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (event_kind = 'hold'::text AND event_slot = 'hold'::text AND hold_event_id IS NULL AND hold_invoice_id IS NULL OR event_kind <> 'hold'::text AND event_slot = 'terminal'::text AND hold_event_id IS NOT NULL AND hold_invoice_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: accounting_cashier_events_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (event_kind = 'expiry_refund'::text AND actor_user_id IS NULL AND actor_role = 'system'::text OR event_kind <> 'expiry_refund'::text AND actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND actor_role <> 'system'::text)

constraints.name: accounting_cashier_events_invoice_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id) REFERENCES settlement_invoices(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

triggers.name: correction_document_append_only
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER correction_document_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.accounting_correction_documents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_accounting_correction_append_only()

constraints.name: accounting_correction_documents_amount_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (amount > 0::numeric AND amount <= 9999999999.99 AND (amount::text <> ALL (ARRAY['NaN'::text, 'Infinity'::text, '-Infinity'::text])) AND amount = round(amount, 2))

constraints.name: accounting_correction_documents_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (incident_id IS NOT NULL OR write_failure_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: accounting_correction_documents_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (isfinite(recorded_at) AND isfinite(issued_at) AND issued_at >= recorded_at AND cardinality(audience_user_ids) >= 1)

constraints.name: accounting_correction_documents_invoice_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id) REFERENCES settlement_invoices(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: credit_change_document_invoice_fk

triggers.name: credit_reduction_operation_exclusive_v1
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER credit_reduction_operation_exclusive_v1 AFTER INSERT ON public.accounting_credit_reduction_operations_v1 DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_credit_reduction_terminal_exclusive_v1()

triggers.name: credit_reduction_operation_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER credit_reduction_operation_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON public.accounting_credit_reduction_operations_v1 FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_credit_reduction_immutable_v1()

triggers.name: zz_accounting_credit_change_deferred_v1
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER zz_accounting_credit_change_deferred_v1 AFTER INSERT ON public.accounting_credit_reduction_operations_v1 DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_accounting_credit_change_deferred_v1()

constraints.name: accounting_credit_reduction_operations_v1_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (NOT ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid = ANY (ARRAY[id, actor_user_id, operation_id, club_id, agent_id, target_user_id])))

constraints.name: accounting_credit_reduction_operations_v1_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (applied_reduction = LEAST(requested_reduction, before_limit) AND after_limit = (before_limit - applied_reduction))

constraints.name: accounting_credit_reduction_operations_v1_check2
constraints.definition:
CHECK (assignment_reason =
CASE
    WHEN reason IS NULL OR reason = ''::text THEN 'Credit line reduced'::text
    ELSE reason
END)

constraints.name: accounting_credit_reduction_operations_v1_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (applied_reduction > 0::numeric AND NOT before_prepaid AND before_limit > 0::numeric AND credit_used <= after_limit AND after_prepaid = (after_limit = 0::numeric) AND after_revision::numeric = (before_revision::numeric + 1::numeric) AND assignment_id IS NOT NULL AND document_id IS NOT NULL AND invoice_id IS NOT NULL AND assignment_id <> document_id AND assignment_id <> invoice_id AND document_id <> invoice_id OR applied_reduction = 0::numeric AND before_limit = 0::numeric AND after_limit = 0::numeric AND credit_used = 0::numeric AND before_prepaid AND after_prepaid AND before_revision = after_revision AND assignment_id IS NULL AND document_id IS NULL AND invoice_id IS NULL)

triggers.name: immutable_launch_positions

triggers.name: accounting_invoice_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER accounting_invoice_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.settlement_invoices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_accounting_document_immutable()

triggers.name: trg_weekly_statement_issue_settled
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_weekly_statement_issue_settled BEFORE INSERT ON public.settlement_invoices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_weekly_statement_issue_settled()

constraints.name: accounting_invoice_has_one_source
constraints.definition: CHECK (source_union_presettlement_id IS NULL AND (source_credit_reduction_operation_id IS NULL AND invoice_type <> 'credit_limit_change'::text AND num_nonnulls(source_ledger_id, source_credit_invoice_id, source_credit_payment_id) <= 1 AND (period_id IS NOT NULL OR num_nonnulls(source_ledger_id, source_credit_invoice_id, source_credit_payment_id) = 1) OR source_credit_reduction_operation_id IS NOT NULL AND invoice_type = 'credit_limit_change'::text AND period_id IS NULL AND num_nonnulls(source_ledger_id, source_credit_invoice_id, source_credit_payment_id) = 0) OR source_union_presettlement_id IS NOT NULL AND invoice_type = 'transaction_receipt'::text AND NOT (breakdown ->> 'category'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'union_presettlement'::text AND from_entity_type = 'union'::text AND to_entity_type = 'club'::text AND status = 'paid'::text AND chips_transferred IS FALSE AND period_id IS NULL AND source_ledger_id IS NULL AND source_credit_invoice_id IS NULL AND source_credit_payment_id IS NULL AND source_credit_reduction_operation_id IS NULL AND transferred_at IS NULL AND due_at IS NULL AND chip_transfer_id IS NULL)

constraints.name: ck_whole_cents
constraints.definition: CHECK (created_at < '2026-09-07 22:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone OR net_amount = round(net_amount, 2) AND gross_amount = round(gross_amount, 2)) NOT VALID

constraints.name: settlement_invoices_club_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (club_id) REFERENCES clubs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: settlement_invoices_period_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (period_id) REFERENCES settlement_periods(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
